title: Support matrix
description: Which engine versions may be installed, on which operating systems and architectures, and when each version stops being supported upstream. Basewright never chooses a version; a human does, and this file is what that choice is validated against.

default_version.description: The version used when the request does not name one. It must appear in versions, which the loader checks.

version.description: An engine version as the vendor writes it, quoted so that 16 does not become the number sixteen.

eol.description: The date upstream support ends. A version approaching it produces a warning, not a refusal: the operator is told, and decides.

status.description: Absent means supported. allowed_with_warning is for a version that is still maintained upstream but is not what a new instance should be built on.

items.description: The processor architectures this version is built for. Only what the vendor actually publishes packages for belongs here.

family.description: Packaging family. Must be one of the families declared in profile.yml.
